business_summary: BlackRock Multi-Sector Income Trust is a close ended fixed income mutual fund launched by BlackRock, Inc. It is co-managed by BlackRock Advisors, LLC and BlackRock (Singapore) Limited. The fund invests in fixed income markets. It invests primarily in loan and debt instruments and other investments with similar economic characteristic. BlackRock Multi-Sector Income Trust was formed on February 25, 2013 and is domiciled in the United States.
business_summary_ko: BlackRock Multi-Sector Income Trust는 BlackRock, Inc.가 출시한 폐쇄형 채권 뮤추얼 펀드입니다. BlackRock Advisors, LLC와 BlackRock (Singapore) Limited가 공동 관리합니다. 본 펀드는 채권 시장에 투자합니다. 주로 대출, 채무상품 및 유사한 경제적 특성을 지닌 기타 투자에 투자합니다. BlackRock Multi-Sector Income Trust는 2013년 2월 25일에 설립되었으며 미국에 주소를 두고 있습니다.
